title: Wright Brothers Adventure Helicopter Tour
includes: WEIGHT LIMIT 300LBS PER PERSON - 580LBS PER GROUP
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum 2 Per Flight - Maximum 3 Per Flight
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take a breathtaking helicopter flight over the Outer Banks, where aviation history began. Soar above the iconic Wright Brothers National Memorial, witness the stunning Roanoke Sound, and explore Nags Head Beach and Jockey's Ridge State Park from the sky. This 18-20 minute tour offers a unique perspective of the landscape that inspired the first powered flight, perfect for families, history enthusiasts, and adventure seekers. Enjoy live narration, window seats, and the chance to spot dolphins and turtles as you glide above the beautiful coastline.

- Duration of 18-20 minutes with a 30-minute overall experience
- Minimum of 2 and maximum of 3 passengers per flight
- Max 300lbs Per Seat and 540lbs Per Flight
- Scenic views of historic landmarks and the Outer Banks coastline
- All window seats and live narration enhance your tour experience
